offset: If x offsets y, the loss (because) of y is balanced by x.

If you offset x against y, you compare of contrast them.

offspring: An offspring is either the sons, daughters, or immediate descendants of a human, animal or plant.

offend: An act when someone makes another person unhappy. To offend someone is to make them feel disgust.

off-season: In sports, an off-season is when no games in a particular sport are played.

oftentimes: To do something oftentimes means you do it many times.

offhand: An offhand comment, manner, joke, etc. is one that is made without careful thought.

offhandedly: If something is done or being made offhandedly, it is done or being made without thinking and planning.
offload: If you offload something, you unload it.

offal: Offal is the internal organs of an animal that is used as food.
offshore: In the sea, away from the shore.
